animal.name: Elephant
animal.description: Elephants are the largest land animals, known for their long trunks and tusks. They are gentle herbivores that eat grass, fruits, and bark.

animal.name: Tiger
animal.description: Tigers are powerful big cats with orange fur and black stripes. They are carnivores and hunt animals like deer for food.

animal.name: Lion
animal.description: Lions are known as the "king of the jungle" and live in groups called prides. They are fierce carnivores that mainly eat large herbivores.

animal.name: Deer
animal.description: Deer are graceful animals with antlers and a strong sense of hearing. They are herbivores and feed on leaves, grass, and fruits.

animal.name: Tortoise
animal.description: Tortoises are slow-moving reptiles with hard, dome-shaped shells. Most are herbivores, eating plants, while some species may eat insects.
